Boys don't have a growth spurt

questions.prompt: Many teenagers feel worried or confused about the changes of adolescence. Suggest three ways a school could support students, and explain why each helps.
questions.modelAnswer: 1) Age-appropriate science lessons that explain the changes clearly and factually, which replaces myths and fear with understanding. 2) Access to a trusted counsellor or teacher, and helplines, so students can ask private questions and get support for stress or low mood. 3) Practical support such as clean toilets, sanitary products and health check-ups, and a respectful culture where teasing about body changes is not accepted. These help students feel safe, informed and respected.
rubric: Includes emotional as well as physical wellbeing
questions.explain: Criterion D: care for your community.
